name: FlareSolverr
summary: Gets past the anti-bot checks some search sites use, for Prowlarr.
after_install: Nothing to open — this has no interface. Tell Prowlarr about it: Settings, Indexers, add a FlareSolverr proxy with the host http://flaresolverr:8191, give it the tag "cloudflare", then put that same tag on each indexer that needs it. Only tag the ones that fail, because every request through here drives a real browser and is far slower than a direct one.

storage.description: Scratch space. Nothing here is worth keeping.
